verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS platform that ships a mobile app, a local MCP server and an agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or any way to opt out of them. The security and authorization material is about compliance, not tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
